tutorial.step.welcome.title: Welcome to Espetro
tutorial.step.welcome.body: This is a guided live-match tutorial covering Espetro features. Use Next, or Skip for this session. Re-open anytime with /espetro tutorial.
tutorial.step.team_select.title: Pick Attack / Defend
tutorial.step.team_select.body: Choose Attack or Defend on join. Press K if the team UI closes. When enough players have joined, commander voting starts.
tutorial.step.phase_overview.title: Match Phases
tutorial.step.phase_overview.body: Flow: Waiting → Defend commander vote → Attack commander vote → Defend faction select → Attack faction select → Reveal → Deploy → Battle.
tutorial.step.keys_kjy.title: Keybinds
tutorial.step.keys_kjy.body: K: team/state, J: class (deploy/battle), Y: commander skills (deploy/battle). Remap in Controls.
tutorial.step.commander_vote.title: Commander Vote
tutorial.step.commander_vote.body: Your side votes for a commander. Commanders get skills, bastions, and vehicles. Timeouts auto-resolve by votes.
tutorial.step.faction_select.title: Faction (TO&E) Select
tutorial.step.faction_select.body: Commanders pick a faction loadout from a random pool. This chooses classes/vehicles for the team — not your personal class.
tutorial.step.faction_reveal.title: Faction Reveal
tutorial.step.faction_reveal.body: Both final factions are shown briefly, then deployment begins.
tutorial.step.deploy_overview.title: Deployment Phase
tutorial.step.deploy_overview.body: Open the unified deploy panel to pick class, spawn points, and squads. Defenders fortify; attackers usually wait in a barrier zone.
tutorial.step.deploy_attack_wait.title: Attack: Waiting
tutorial.step.deploy_attack_wait.body: Attackers wait behind barriers. Use the time to set class, squad, and spawn plan before battle starts.
tutorial.step.deploy_defend_build.title: Defend: Fortify
tutorial.step.deploy_defend_build.body: Defenders can use outposts, bastion planning, and squads during deploy. Set class and spawn before battle.
tutorial.step.unified_deploy.title: Unified Deploy Panel
tutorial.step.unified_deploy.body: Pick class on the left and a spawn option (default, bastion, team pack, outpost). Prefer spawn first, then class. Squad tools are here too.
tutorial.step.class_select.title: Class Selection
tutorial.step.class_select.body: Classes have caps and troop cost. Selecting grants gear/stats. Press J again in deploy/battle when allowed.
tutorial.step.squad.title: Squads
tutorial.step.squad.body: Create/join/leave/delete squads. Leaders get a team pack for a squad rally point. Squads are team-isolated.
tutorial.step.bastion.title: Bastions
tutorial.step.bastion.body: Commanders use the bastion wand with planks to build respawn/resupply nodes. There is a per-team cap and build cooldown.
tutorial.step.team_pack.title: Team Pack
tutorial.step.team_pack.body: Squad leaders can place a pack block as a squad respawn node. Watch durability, break rules, and cooldown.
tutorial.step.outpost.title: Outposts
tutorial.step.outpost.body: Defend-only during deployment. Pick an outpost spawn from the deploy panel. Outposts are disabled when battle starts.
tutorial.step.vehicle.title: Vehicles
tutorial.step.vehicle.body: Commanders deploy faction vehicles via stick/UI/commands. Mind caps, cooldowns, and troop cost on vehicle loss.
tutorial.step.commander_skills.title: Commander Skills
tutorial.step.commander_skills.body: Press Y for skills (KubeJS-driven). Defaults: drone detect, vehicle supply station, 155 artillery. Watch cooldowns.
tutorial.step.skill_drone.title: Skill: Drone Detect
tutorial.step.skill_drone.body: Highlights enemy players in range for recon. Check cooldown and radius.
tutorial.step.skill_supply.title: Skill: Vehicle Supply Station
tutorial.step.skill_supply.body: Deploys a supply setup for vehicles. Mind placement and cooldown.
tutorial.step.skill_arty.title: Skill: 155 Artillery
tutorial.step.skill_arty.body: Pick a map target for fire support. Full map targeting needs ESPoints on client and server.
tutorial.step.battle_start.title: Battle Starts
tutorial.step.battle_start.body: Barriers drop, outposts die, troop budgets apply. Deaths cost class troop value; commander deaths add a penalty. Respawn via the deploy panel.
tutorial.step.stamina.title: Stamina
tutorial.step.stamina.body: Sprinting drains stamina over time; jumps cost per jump. After idle delay, stamina regenerates. A thin bar under the crosshair shows remaining stamina.
tutorial.step.troops.title: Troop HUD
tutorial.step.troops.body: HUD shows remaining attack/defend troops. Deaths, commander penalty, and vehicle losses reduce the budget.
tutorial.step.nametag.title: Teammate Nametags
tutorial.step.nametag.body: Teammate nametags appear within teammate_name_tag_distance from game.json.
tutorial.step.resupply.title: Bastion Resupply
tutorial.step.resupply.body: Interact with your team's bastion shulker to resupply ammo if the class has resupply config. Respect cooldowns.
tutorial.step.respawn_flow.title: Death & Respawn
tutorial.step.respawn_flow.body: After death, open the deploy panel, pick bastion/pack/deploy point, then class. Prefer spawn first, then class.
tutorial.step.mid_join.title: Mid-Game Join
tutorial.step.mid_join.body: Joining after start requires picking a side, then following the current phase UI. In deploy/battle, set spawn and class quickly.
